data.name: Gaile
data.gender_notes: Gaile is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gaile is derived from the Greek word 'gaelos', meaning joyful or rejoicing. In Christian tradition, Gaile is the name of a messenger or angel, emphasizing the joy and happiness that comes from spreading God's word. The name Gaile carries the meaning “Joyful messenger” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gaile usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful messenger and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrier of God's love and joy

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gaile total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: גאילה נגזר מהשורש העברי ג-א-ל שפירושו לגאול או לשמח. השם גאילה מופיע בתנ"ך ככינויה של הנביאה שמחה על התגשמות הבטחות ה', ומשמעותו היא שמחה או שיר של שמחה. השם משקף את שמחת האמונה והגאולה המשיחית.

in_greek.name: Γαΐλη
in_greek.meaning: Γαΐλη σημαίνει χαρά ή ωδή χαράς
in_greek.long_meaning: Γαΐλη προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή λέξη גאילה (Ga'ilah) που σημαίνει χαρά ή ωδή χαράς. Στο πλαίσιο της Καινής Διαθήκης, το όνομα αυτό αντανακλά τη χαρά και την ελπίδα που προσφέρει η πίστη στον Χριστό.

in_latin.name: Gaile
in_latin.meaning: Gaile significat gaudium vel canticum gaudii
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Gaile derivatur ex hebraeo גאילה (Ga'ilah), quod gaudium vel canticum gaudii significat. In traditione christiana, nomen Gaile reflectit gaudium et spem quae per fidem in Christum offertur.

in_english.name: Gaile
in_english.meaning: Gaile means joyful or happy melody
in_english.long_meaning: The name Gaile originates from the Hebrew root ג-א-ל (g-al), meaning to redeem or rejoice. Gaile signifies joy, happiness, or a joyful melody. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, the name reflects the themes of redemption and joy central to Christian faith. Historically, names with similar roots have been used to express praise and thanksgiving. Gaile is associated with positive personality traits like optimism and enthusiasm.
